field_descriptions.diet_features: Nutritional information specific to the dietary plan. May include dietary recommendations on what foods to avoid, what foods to consume, and specific alterations/deviations from the USDA or other regulatory body's approved dietary guidelines.
field_descriptions.endorsers: People or organizations that endorse the plan.
field_descriptions.expert_considerations: Medical expert advice related to the plan.
field_descriptions.identifier: The identifier property represents any kind of identifier for any kind of [[Thing]], such as ISBNs, GTIN codes, UUIDs etc. Schema.org provides dedicated properties for representing many of these, either as textual strings or as URL (URI) links. See [background notes](/docs/datamodel.html#identifierBg) for more details.
field_descriptions.physiological_benefits: Specific physiologic benefits associated to the plan.
field_descriptions.risks: Specific physiologic risks associated to the diet plan.
